title: STARTTLS handler has no comment explaining why it always returns 454
description: session.rs STARTTLS arm returns 454 with no comment. A contributor seeing this will assume it's a stub they should complete, or file a bug report. The advertise-but-reject logic is especially confusing because EHLO does advertise STARTTLS when configured. What would make it clear: a comment like '// STARTTLS negotiation not yet implemented (v1 scope); above bug stoa-9f393084.3 tracks removing this from the EHLO advertisement until it is.'.
